meta.title: Study in Japan
meta.description: World-class universities, MEXT scholarships, and a rich cultural experience await Nepali students in Japan.

hero.label: Study Abroad
hero.heading: Study in Japan
hero.body: Japan offers excellent academic institutions and generous government scholarships. With strong demand for international students and a high quality of life, it remains one of Nepal's most popular study destinations.

highlights.title: MEXT Scholarship
highlights.body: The Japanese Government Scholarship (MEXT) fully funds undergraduate and graduate study, covering tuition, travel, and a monthly stipend.

highlights.title: Language Support
highlights.body: Universities offer Japanese language programmes and English-taught courses. Learning Japanese opens doors in one of the world's largest economies.

highlights.title: Part-Time Work Rights
highlights.body: Student visas permit up to 28 hours of part-time work per week, helping cover living costs in cities like Tokyo and Osaka.

highlights.title: Safety & Quality of Life
highlights.body: Japan consistently ranks among the safest countries in the world, with excellent public transport, healthcare, and a welcoming culture.

highlights.title: World-Class Research
highlights.body: Japanese universities excel in engineering, robotics, medicine, and natural sciences, with deep industry ties and cutting-edge facilities.

highlights.title: Cultural Richness
highlights.body: From ancient temples to modern pop culture, studying in Japan is a transformative personal experience alongside world-class academics.
